messages:
maya: Heads-up — need a quick capacity check for a late-night burst test this Friday (UTC ~02:00). Target: 8x A100s for ~2 hours in eu-west1. Do we have project quota + a vendor fallback? Also want the run isolated to the `perf-test` project/namespace.

tonny: We only have 4 A100s available in project-redwood-eu right now. Anything above that needs billing/commit approval.

riley: Procurement pinged GCP yesterday for a quota bump, still pending. Akira from RackVendor replied that they can provide 4 A100s in eu-west but require 24h notice and an SOW.

maya: Can we run a mixed pool (4 GCP + 4 vendor) and keep low-latency between instances? We need KV cache warmup to happen quickly.

chandra: Network-wise we can make it work via a site-to-site VPN/peer — the vendor pool would live in a routed subnet and traffic can hit the same VPC via a proxy. Need a CIDR to reserve + firewall rules. Example rule below: 

```
gcloud compute firewall-rules create perf-test-ingress --network perf-vpc --allow tcp:22,tcp:443 --source-ranges=10.10.0.0/24
```

procurement-bot: Quota bump request created: REQ-1234 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REQ-1234) — assigned to @tony.

oncall-ryan: FYI — if we use vendor fallback, run a short canary (30m) before the full job to validate NVLink/cross-rack perf and our fallback paths. Also set a lower token batch size for the first 10 minutes.

akira-vendor: Ack from vendor side — can reserve 4x A100s for Fri 02:00–04:00 CET if we get confirmation by EOD Thu. We'll need an SSH key + public ASN for routing.

maya: Thanks — chandra can you post the exact CIDR + steps? tony, can you escalate the finance/billing approval referencing REQ-1234? I'll update the perf-run runbook and schedule the canary.

chandra: Posting the CIDR we recommend: 10.10.0.0/24. Steps: 1) reserve subnet on perf-vpc, 2) add firewall rule above, 3) share vendor ASN + peer IP, 4) add static routes to vendor subnet.

tonny: On it — escalation email to finance sent with link to REQ-1234 and tentative cost estimate.

maya: Great, will follow up tomorrow with final run times and runbook link.
